Description: Comfortable walking at an individually appropriate pace.
Benefits: General aerobic activity and everyday movement.
Modification_T1: Use a comfortable pace and duration.
Modification_T2: Slow pace or shorter sessions may be appropriate.
Modification_Notes: Build gradually and listen to your body.
Instructions: Choose a pace where conversation remains possible.

Description: Walking at a pace that raises activity level while conversation remains possible.
Modification_T1: Begin gradually if not previously active.
Modification_T2: Adjust pace and duration according to comfort.
Modification_T3: Reduce pace or duration as needed.
Modification_Notes: Do not push through discomfort.
Instructions: Maintain a pace where normal conversation is possible.

Description: Swimming at a comfortable intensity in a suitable pool.
Benefits: Low-impact aerobic activity with water support.
Modification_T1: Start gently if new to swimming.
Modification_T3: Reduce intensity or duration if uncomfortable.
Modification_Notes: Stay hydrated and avoid overheating.
Instructions: Use a safe pool environment.

Description: Walking forwards backwards or sideways in suitable water.
Modification_T2: Adjust direction and duration for comfort.
Modification_Notes: Do not continue if movement increases pain.
Instructions: Move at a comfortable pace.

Description: Cycling on a stationary bike with controlled resistance.
Benefits: Aerobic activity without outdoor balance demands.
Modification_T1: Adjust seat and resistance for comfort.
Modification_T2: Lower resistance and duration as needed.
Modification_Notes: Stop if dizzy painful or unwell.
Instructions: Keep intensity comfortable and avoid overheating.

Description: Standing with shoulders and bottom against a wall while gently flattening the back.
Modification_Notes: Move slowly and avoid forcing the movement.
Instructions: Repeat gently as comfortable.

Description: Controlled hands-and-knees movement between neutral and a gentle rounded back.
Modification_T1: Use a smaller range if needed.
Modification_T2: Only move as far as comfortable.
Modification_Notes: Do not use it to self-treat severe or persistent pain.
Instructions: Stop if pain occurs.

Description: From hands and knees gently round the lower back and return.
Modification_Notes: Stop if pain occurs.
Instructions: Move slowly and comfortably.

Description: From all fours move hips back only as comfortable with space for the abdomen.
Modification_T2: Use a wider knee position if needed.
Modification_Notes: Do not force the stretch.
Instructions: Not intended to treat a medical condition.

Description: Seated pelvic movement using a chair or suitable exercise ball.
Modification_T1: Use a stable chair if preferred.
Modification_Notes: Stop if pain or dizziness occurs.
Instructions: Move gently without forcing range.

Description: Briefly tighten the pelvic floor and relax while breathing normally.
Modification_Notes: Breathe normally and fully relax between contractions.
Instructions: Follow pregnancy-appropriate pelvic-floor guidance.

Description: Gently tighten the pelvic floor and hold for a comfortable period before relaxing.
Modification_Notes: Do not strain.
Instructions: Breathe normally.

Description: Consciously release the pelvic floor after each contraction.
Modification_T1: Take longer rest periods if needed.
Modification_Notes: Stop if discomfort develops.
Instructions: Relax fully between contractions.

Description: Comfortable controlled stretching without bouncing or forcing range.
Modification_T1: Keep movements smaller as balance changes.
Modification_Notes: Stop if pain occurs.
Instructions: Use slow controlled movements.

Description: Pregnancy-specific gentle yoga using modified positions and focused breathing.
Modification_Notes: Stop if pain or feeling unwell occurs.
Instructions: Prefer pregnancy-specific instruction.

Description: Gentle pregnancy-appropriate relaxation practice within prenatal yoga.
Modification_Notes: Stop if uncomfortable or unwell.
Instructions: Keep breathing comfortable.

Description: Slow comfortable breathing without forceful breathing or prolonged breath holding.
Modification_T3: Do not deliberately hold the breath.
Modification_Notes: Stop if dizzy or unwell.
Instructions: Keep breathing natural and comfortable.

Description: Pregnancy-appropriate low-impact movement such as a gentle pregnancy class.
Modification_Notes: Avoid overheating and stop if unwell.
Instructions: Use the conversation test.

Description: Controlled strengthening using suitable weights or resistance bands when appropriate.
Modification_T1: Use light resistance and controlled movement.
Modification_T2: Modify position and load for comfort.
Modification_Notes: Avoid jerky or high-impact movements.
Instructions: Seek professional guidance when unsure about an individual program.

Description: Low-impact aerobic class specifically designed for pregnancy.
Modification_T1: Tell the instructor the pregnancy week.
Modification_Notes: Stop if pain or feeling unwell occurs.
Instructions: Use a qualified instructor familiar with pregnancy exercise.

Description: Pregnancy-appropriate water-based exercise with controlled intensity.
Benefits: Low-impact aerobic movement with water support.
Modification_T1: Begin with short sessions if new.
Modification_Notes: Stop if symptoms worsen or you feel unwell.
Instructions: Stay hydrated.

Description: A short sequence of comfortable movement used to break up periods of sitting or inactivity.
Modification_Notes: Do not push through significant pain.
Instructions: Keep movement easy and controlled.

Description: Short walking periods separated by comfortable rest breaks.
Modification_T2: Shorten walking periods and increase breaks.
Modification_Notes: Stop if pain dizziness or feeling unwell occurs.
Instructions: Increase activity gradually.

Description: Gentle pregnancy-focused stretching combined with comfortable breathing.
Modification_Notes: Stop if pain or feeling unwell occurs.
Instructions: Keep movements controlled and breathing comfortable.

Description: Alternating gentle knee lifts while seated on a stable chair.
Benefits: Gentle circulation and movement during low-energy periods.
Modification_T2: Slow the pace or reduce repetitions.
Modification_T3: Use a supported chair and pause often.
Modification_Notes: Keep both feet controlled and avoid leaning backward.
Instructions: Sit tall and alternate comfortable knee lifts without holding the breath.

Description: Gentle side steps with a light touch of the opposite foot.
Modification_T2: Use a wall or chair for balance.
Modification_T3: Keep steps small and use support as needed.
Modification_Notes: Avoid quick direction changes if balance feels different.
Instructions: Step gently to one side, bring the other foot in, then alternate.

Description: Slowly lifting the heels and lowering them while standing with optional support.
Benefits: Gentle lower-leg movement and balance practice.
Modification_T3: Keep one or both hands supported if needed.
Modification_Notes: Move slowly and avoid bouncing.
Instructions: Hold support, rise onto the balls of the feet, then lower slowly.

Description: Alternating low knee lifts performed at a comfortable standing pace.
Modification_T3: Use support and lift only as high as comfortable.
Modification_Notes: Avoid lifting high enough to affect balance.
Instructions: Alternate small knee lifts while keeping the trunk upright and breathing normally.

Description: Alternating toe taps forward or slightly to the side from a stable chair.
Benefits: Gentle leg movement with minimal balance demand.
Modification_T3: Keep both feet close to the floor and pause as needed.
Modification_Notes: Keep the chair stable and posture comfortable.
Instructions: Tap one foot gently forward, return, and alternate sides.

Description: Slowly shifting body weight from one foot to the other with support available.
Benefits: Gentle balance awareness and lower-body mobility.
Modification_T3: Keep one or both hands on stable support.
Modification_Notes: Do not challenge balance aggressively.
Instructions: Stand near support and slowly shift weight side to side without locking the knees.

Description: Slow controlled shoulder circles in a comfortable range.
Benefits: Gentle upper-body mobility and tension release.
Modification_T2: Reduce range if shoulders feel tight.
Modification_T3: Perform seated if standing is tiring.
Modification_Notes: Avoid forcing the shoulders backward or upward.
Instructions: Roll shoulders slowly up, back, down, and forward, then reverse.

Description: Gentle side-to-side neck stretch without pulling on the head.
Modification_T3: Perform seated with back support if needed.
Modification_Notes: Do not circle the neck aggressively or force the range.
Instructions: Keep shoulders relaxed and gently tilt the head toward one shoulder.

Description: Gentle seated side bend with the opposite side lengthening.
Benefits: Comfortable trunk mobility and side-body stretch.
Modification_Notes: Avoid deep twisting or forcing the stretch.
Instructions: Sit tall and gently lean to one side without collapsing forward.

Description: Gentle calf stretch using a wall for balance.
Benefits: Calf flexibility and comfortable lower-leg movement.
Modification_T3: Keep both hands on the wall and shorten the stance.
Modification_Notes: Avoid bouncing or forcing the heel down.
Instructions: Place one foot behind, keep the heel comfortable, and gently shift weight forward.

Description: Gentle hamstring stretch using a chair or low stable support.
Modification_T1: Keep the leg only slightly extended.
Modification_T3: Use a higher support and keep the back neutral.
Modification_Notes: Do not force the knee straight or round the back.
Instructions: Place one heel on a stable low support and hinge slightly from the hips.

Description: Slow ankle circles performed seated or standing with support.
Modification_Notes: Stop if movement causes pain.
Instructions: Lift one foot slightly and make slow circles in both directions.

Description: Gentle chest-opening movement with shoulders relaxed and arms comfortable.
Modification_Notes: Avoid pulling the shoulders forcefully backward.
Instructions: Gently draw the shoulder blades toward each other without arching the lower back.

Description: Small supported split-stance stretch focused on the front of the hip.
Modification_T3: Keep a hand on support and use a small range.
Modification_Notes: Avoid deep lunging or pelvic pain.
Instructions: Stand in a short split stance and gently bend the front knee while keeping the movement small.

Exercise_Name: Pelvic floor gentle lift and release
Description: Gently lift the pelvic floor and then fully release it.
Modification_Notes: Full relaxation between repetitions is important.
Instructions: Gently lift the pelvic floor while breathing normally, then release completely.

Description: A comfortable sustained pelvic-floor contraction followed by full relaxation.
Modification_T3: Use a supported seated position if standing is tiring.
Modification_Notes: Do not strain or hold the breath.
Instructions: Squeeze gently for a comfortable period, breathe normally, then relax fully.

Description: Short gentle pelvic-floor contractions followed by deliberate release.
Modification_Notes: Do not keep the muscles continuously clenched.
Instructions: Gently contract, release immediately, and allow the muscles to relax before repeating.

Description: Gentle pelvic-floor contraction coordinated with a comfortable exhale.
Modification_Notes: Never hold the breath.
Instructions: Exhale comfortably while gently contracting, then inhale and release.

Description: Pelvic-floor contractions practiced in a stable seated position.
Benefits: Convenient pelvic-floor practice with low balance demand.
Modification_Notes: Relax the abdomen and buttocks rather than gripping everything.
Instructions: Sit comfortably, gently contract the pelvic floor, then completely release.

Description: Pelvic-floor contractions practiced while standing comfortably.
Modification_T3: Keep one hand on a stable support.
Modification_Notes: Avoid breath holding or straining.
Instructions: Stand comfortably near support and perform gentle squeeze-and-release repetitions.

Description: Gentle pelvic-floor activation practice associated with a simulated cough preparation.
Benefits: Awareness of pelvic-floor activation during pressure events.
Modification_T1: Practice without an actual forceful cough.
Modification_T3: Perform seated if balance is reduced.
Modification_Notes: This is coordination practice, not forceful straining.
Instructions: Gently contract the pelvic floor just before a light simulated cough, then relax.

Description: Comfortable breathing while consciously releasing pelvic-floor tension.
Benefits: Promotes awareness of relaxation after contractions.
Modification_Notes: Do not force the pelvic floor downward.
Instructions: Breathe slowly and notice the pelvic floor softening on each exhale.

Description: Gentle practice of light, medium, then light pelvic-floor contraction followed by release.
Modification_Notes: Avoid maximum-effort squeezing.
Instructions: Gradually increase to a comfortable moderate contraction, then reduce and fully release.

Description: A small set of brief pelvic-floor pulses with complete relaxation between pulses.
Modification_Notes: Stop if pelvic discomfort develops.
Instructions: Perform brief gentle squeezes followed by full release after each pulse.

Description: Brief practice noticing pelvic-floor tension and relaxation without forceful contraction.
Modification_Notes: The goal is awareness, not maximum contraction.
Instructions: Notice tension, soften the pelvic floor, breathe normally, and repeat gently.

Description: A short routine combining comfortable slow contractions, quick contractions, and full relaxation.
Modification_Notes: Prioritize quality and relaxation over quantity.
Instructions: Complete a few slow squeezes, a few quick squeezes, and finish with full relaxation.

Description: Comfortable upright standing posture with relaxed shoulders and steady breathing.
Modification_Notes: Avoid locking the knees or forcing posture.
Instructions: Stand tall with feet comfortable, soften the knees, and breathe naturally.

Description: Modified warrior II with a comfortable stance and optional support.
Benefits: Gentle leg strength, mobility, and balance awareness.
Modification_T3: Use support and a wider stable stance.
Modification_Notes: Avoid deep lunges and balance challenges.
Instructions: Take a comfortable wide stance, bend the front knee slightly, and keep the torso upright.

Description: Gentle wide-stance squat with shallow knee bend and support.
Modification_Notes: Avoid deep squatting or discomfort in the pelvis.
Instructions: Stand comfortably wide, bend the knees slightly, then return to standing.

Description: Modified tree pose using a wall or chair for balance.
Modification_T1: Keep both feet closer to the floor.
Modification_T3: Keep the lifted foot low or use toe support.
Modification_Notes: Do not place the foot against the knee joint; prioritize stability.
Instructions: Stand near support and place the free foot lightly against the ankle or lower leg.

Description: Comfortable seated position with soles of feet together and knees relaxed outward.
Modification_T2: Move feet farther from the body.
Modification_T3: Use extra cushions under hips or knees.
Modification_Notes: Do not press the knees down.
Instructions: Sit comfortably, bring soles together if comfortable, and let the knees relax naturally.

Description: Gentle side stretch from a stable seated position.
Modification_T3: Use a chair with back support.
Modification_Notes: Avoid deep twisting.
Instructions: Sit tall and reach one arm gently overhead while leaning slightly to the opposite side.

Description: Slow pregnancy-appropriate movement between neutral and gentle spinal flexion.
Modification_T3: Widen knees and use cushions if needed.
Modification_Notes: Move slowly and avoid forcing the abdomen or back.
Instructions: On hands and knees, gently round the spine and return to neutral.

Description: Modified wide-knee child's pose with space for the abdomen and optional cushions.
Modification_T3: Widen knees and support the chest/abdomen as needed.
Modification_Notes: Omit if the position is uncomfortable.
Instructions: From hands and knees, gently move hips back only as far as comfortable with the abdomen accommodated.

Description: Small seated forward hinge with a long comfortable spine rather than a deep fold.
Modification_T3: Use chair support and avoid compressing the abdomen.
Modification_Notes: Avoid deep forward folding.
Instructions: Sit with feet apart and gently hinge forward from the hips only as far as comfortable.

Description: Gentle standing side stretch with one hand supported.
Modification_T3: Keep the supporting hand on a wall.
Modification_Notes: Avoid deep side bending.
Instructions: Hold support, reach the opposite arm gently overhead, and lean slightly.

Description: Slow ankle and wrist movements coordinated with comfortable breathing.
Benefits: Gentle joint mobility and movement breaks.
Modification_T3: Perform seated if balance is reduced.
Modification_Notes: Avoid rapid or forced joint movements.
Instructions: Circle the ankles and wrists slowly in both directions while breathing comfortably.

Description: Supported seated or side-supported relaxation with comfortable breathing.
Modification_T3: Prefer side-supported or seated positioning rather than prolonged flat-back lying.
Modification_Notes: Choose the position that feels most comfortable.
Instructions: Settle into a supported position and breathe naturally for a few comfortable minutes.

Description: Slow comfortable breathing that allows the abdomen and lower ribs to move naturally.
Modification_Notes: Do not force deep breaths or hold the breath.
Instructions: Breathe in comfortably through the nose if comfortable and allow the ribs and abdomen to expand naturally.

Description: Comfortable breathing with an exhale slightly longer than the inhale.
Modification_T2: Use equal inhale and exhale if preferred.
Modification_Notes: Never strain to lengthen the exhale.
Instructions: Inhale gently and allow a slightly longer relaxed exhale without breath holding.

Description: Gentle counting of breaths to encourage a steady rhythm.
Modification_T2: Stop counting if it feels effortful.
Modification_Notes: The count should never restrict natural breathing.
Instructions: Choose an easy count for inhale and exhale and keep the breathing comfortable.

Description: Gentle humming during the exhale while breathing naturally between repetitions.
Modification_Notes: Stop if humming feels uncomfortable or causes dizziness.
Instructions: Take a comfortable breath in and make a soft hum during the exhale.

Description: Slow breathing out through gently narrowed lips.
Modification_Notes: Do not force the exhale.
Instructions: Inhale comfortably, then exhale gently through softly pursed lips.

Description: Breathing practice combined with consciously relaxing the shoulders.
Modification_T3: Use a chair with back support.
Modification_Notes: Do not deliberately tense the shoulders first.
Instructions: Breathe naturally and let the shoulders soften on each exhale.

Description: Slow breathing while noticing areas of tension and comfort through the body.
Modification_T2: Focus on one or two areas.
Modification_Notes: This is a relaxation practice, not pain treatment.
Instructions: Breathe comfortably and gently notice the jaw, shoulders, back, hands, and legs.

Description: Steady inhale and exhale rhythm without breath holds.
Modification_T2: Return to natural breathing if needed.
Modification_Notes: No breath holding is required.
Instructions: Use a smooth repeating inhale-exhale rhythm that never feels restrictive.

Description: A short set of comfortable breaths used as a gentle morning routine.
Benefits: Relaxation and mindful start to the day.
Modification_Notes: Stop if light-headed.
Instructions: Sit comfortably and take several natural, unforced breaths.

Description: Slow comfortable breathing used as part of an evening wind-down routine.
Modification_T3: Choose a supported side or seated position.
Modification_Notes: Do not use prolonged breath holds.
Instructions: Breathe slowly and comfortably while allowing the shoulders and jaw to relax.

Description: Gentle exhale paired with a small shoulder relaxation movement.
Modification_Notes: Keep the movement easy and avoid neck strain.
Instructions: Inhale naturally; on the exhale, let the shoulders soften downward.

Description: Hands placed lightly on the lower ribs to notice comfortable expansion and release.
Modification_Notes: Do not press on the abdomen.
Instructions: Place hands lightly on the lower ribs and notice them widen gently during inhalation.

Description: Gentle breathing while sequentially relaxing face, shoulders, and hands.
Modification_Notes: Keep all breathing natural.
Instructions: Breathe naturally and soften the face, shoulders, and hands one area at a time.

Description: Brief mindful pauses between normal breaths without holding the breath.
Benefits: Awareness and relaxation during a busy day.
Modification_T1: Keep pauses very brief or omit them.
Modification_Notes: Do not intentionally hold the breath.
Instructions: Take normal breaths and briefly notice how the body feels before the next breath.

Description: Gentle push-up performed against a wall with controlled movement.
Modification_T3: Use a higher or closer support and smaller range.
Modification_Notes: Keep the body aligned and avoid jerky movement.
Instructions: Place hands on a wall, bend elbows gently, then press back to standing.

Description: Controlled standing up from and sitting back onto a stable chair.
Modification_T3: Keep the chair against a stable surface and use support.
Modification_Notes: Move slowly and keep knees comfortable.
Instructions: Stand up from a stable chair and slowly sit back down with control.

Description: Small comfortable squat using a wall or chair for support.
Modification_T3: Use firm support and a wider stance.
Modification_Notes: Avoid deep squatting or pelvic discomfort.
Instructions: Hold support, bend the knees slightly, then return to standing.

Description: Controlled small leg lift to the side while holding support.
Benefits: Gentle hip muscle strengthening and balance practice.
Modification_Notes: Keep the pelvis facing forward and avoid leaning.
Instructions: Hold support and move one leg a short distance to the side, then return.

Description: Small controlled leg movement backward while standing with support.
Modification_Notes: Avoid arching the lower back.
Instructions: Hold support, move one leg gently backward without leaning, then return.

Description: Controlled heel raises while holding stable support.
Benefits: Gentle calf strengthening and ankle movement.
Modification_Notes: Avoid bouncing and maintain steady control.
Instructions: Hold support, rise gently onto the balls of the feet, then lower slowly.

Description: Light resistance curl performed while seated.
Benefits: Gentle arm strengthening with low balance demand.
Modification_T3: Use lighter objects or no weight.
Modification_Notes: Keep wrists neutral and movements controlled.
Instructions: Sit tall and slowly bend and straighten the elbows while holding light resistance.

Description: Gentle controlled arm raise within a comfortable range.
Benefits: Shoulder mobility and light upper-body strengthening.
Modification_T1: Raise only to a comfortable height.
Modification_T3: Keep the back supported and use a smaller range.
Modification_Notes: Avoid painful or forced overhead range.
Instructions: Raise the arms slowly to a comfortable height and lower with control.

Description: Gentle seated rowing motion using a light resistance band.
Modification_T3: Use a stable chair and minimal resistance.
Modification_Notes: Keep shoulders relaxed and avoid jerking.
Instructions: Anchor the band safely, pull elbows gently backward, then return slowly.

Description: Gentle horizontal band pull-apart with light resistance.
Modification_Notes: Keep shoulders down and avoid overextending.
Instructions: Hold a light band and gently move the hands apart, then return with control.

Description: Small supported knee-bend movement against a wall for stability.
Modification_T3: Keep the movement small and supported.
Modification_Notes: Avoid deep knee bending.
Instructions: Stand near a wall, bend both knees slightly, then straighten with control.

Description: Modified hands-and-knees exercise lifting one arm or one leg at a time.
Benefits: Gentle trunk, hip, and back strengthening.
Modification_T1: Lift only one limb at a time.
Modification_T3: Widen knees and use cushions as needed.
Modification_Notes: Keep the spine neutral and stop if the position is uncomfortable.
Instructions: From hands and knees, slowly lift one arm or one leg a small amount, then return and alternate.

Description: Gentle standing chest press using a light resistance band anchored safely behind.
Modification_T3: Use a stable stance and minimal resistance.
Modification_Notes: Ensure the band is securely anchored and avoid jerky movement.
Instructions: Press the hands gently forward against light band resistance, then return slowly.

Description: Controlled straightening of one knee at a time from a stable chair.
Modification_T3: Use a supported chair and small range.
Modification_Notes: Avoid locking the knee forcefully.
Instructions: Sit tall, slowly straighten one knee, then lower the foot and alternate sides.
